messages.subject: Hitachi Energy Thailand | Grid transition, stakeholder alignment and country execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Waruttamapornsu,

Hitachi Energy's role in grid modernization, electrification and the energy transition makes Thailand an especially compelling market for my next international leadership mandate.

At AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, I serve as Liaison Director within the Social Responsibility Department. My work connects senior management with ministries, regulators, communities, industry partners and internal technical teams across a complex mining and energy environment. I manage high-stakes stakeholder matters, regulatory coordination, executive communications and ESG delivery with a strong emphasis on documented closure.

A central part of my recent experience has involved the external and governance dimensions of a large solar and battery-storage transition, approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar and more than 80 MWh of storage, together with carbon-data readiness using physical operational evidence. This gives me a practical perspective on the institutional, social and execution issues surrounding energy transformation, beyond strategy alone.

I see strong value in bringing this combination to Hitachi Energy across Thailand or ASEAN, particularly in external affairs, strategic partnerships, country stakeholder leadership, sustainability or market-facing executive roles. I am reaching you through the Thailand communications office and have attached a Hitachi Energy-focused executive CV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
